name: Moment of Clarity ranks 1 and 2 reduce pushback and reach Sanity Tap's mana gain natively (#918, #939)
contract: Moment of Clarity rank 1 (706179) and rank 2 (707783) (Spell.dbc, read for this scenario) are each passives with two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects, target caster. Effect 0 is aura 149 SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK: rank 1 BasePoints 34 DieSides 1 (+35), rank 2 BasePoints 69 DieSides 1 (+70), matching both tooltips exactly. Its handler is the stock AuraEffect::HandleNoImmediateEffect (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:214): pushback reduction is read directly from the caster's aura list at the point the engine computes pushback, the same mechanism every other class's pushback-reduction talent uses, with no per-spell code. Effect 1 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2): rank 1 BasePoints 4 DieSides 1 (+5), rank 2 BasePoints 9 DieSides 1 (+10), EffectSpellClassMask word 0 bit 12 (4096) on both ranks. Sanity Tap 802575 (read for this scenario) is SpellFamilyName 31 with SpellFamilyFlags word 0 = 4096, an exact match, and is not in the family-31 special-routing switch in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod, so it uses the generic classmask path. grep confirms zero occurrences of 706179/707783 in src/server/coa or src/server/game, matching the issue's own evidence that no per-spell script exists; both effects are native aura/spellmod machinery and need none. spell_modifier(op=12) exercises the live IsAffectedBySpellMod path against Sanity Tap, not just the DBC value.

steps.label: BASELINE: Sanity Tap's SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 modifier is untouched
Rank 1 effect 0 carries the authored +35 pushback reduction
Rank 1 effect 1 carries the authored +5 flat SPELLMOD_EFFECT2
CONTRACT (#918): rank 1 raises Sanity Tap's SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 modifier by +5
Sanity Tap's modifier returns to baseline between ranks
Rank 2 effect 0 carries the authored +70 pushback reduction
Rank 2 effect 1 carries the authored +10 flat SPELLMOD_EFFECT2
CONTRACT (#939): rank 2 raises Sanity Tap's SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 modifier by +10
Sanity Tap's modifier returns to baseline
